summary: Tecogen filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 to disclose a customer testimonial press release dated October 14, 2026. Cloudsmart Inc., a Tier 3, SOC 2 cloud and AI data center in Connecticut, described substantial electric bill savings after months of operating Tecogen's InVerde cogeneration system. No transaction, price, stake, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural or regulatory mechanic is stated. The 8-K simply furnishes Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2. No risk-arb angle exists; this is an ordinary product-marketing current report.
